name: Saint Patrick's Church

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large single-story commercial building with a gray multi-section metal roof|A large paved parking lot surrounds the main structure on multiple sides|Several smaller buildings are located adjacent to the main building and parking areas|Open grassy fields extend to one side of the property|Landscaped plantings and trees are present around the site.

alpha.desc: The front of the facility shows the main building with a gray metal roof and brick entry facade|A large paved parking lot extends in front of the structure with marked spaces|Smaller brown buildings are visible to one side|Landscaped areas and open grass are present near the entrance.

bravo.desc: The left side of the facility shows the side elevation of the main building and portions of the paved parking lot|Smaller secondary buildings and open grassy areas are visible|Trees and fencing run along portions of the property boundary.

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows the back of the main building and an extensive paved parking lot|Multiple smaller brown buildings are arranged near the parking area|Open grassy fields and landscaped borders extend beyond the paved surfaces.

delta.desc: The right side of the facility shows the side of the main building with a large paved parking lot|Secondary structures and open grass are present|Trees and landscaped edges frame portions of this side of the property.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from multiple points via the large paved parking lot that surrounds the main building. The parking lot provides extensive space for emergency vehicle circulation and staging. Multiple secondary buildings are located around the site. Open grassy fields adjoin the paved areas on one side. The layout allows relatively clear movement around the main structure. Neighboring residential properties are present on surrounding streets.
clarifications: Where are the primary vehicle entrances to the parking areas, and are any of them gated or restricted? Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle access route around the main building? Are there multiple points of entry into the main building and secondary structures? Is vehicle access available on all sides of the facility? What is the primary use of the smaller buildings on the property?
